verdict.rationale: Kintsugi says it files and remits on schedule. Its Get Filings API returns a paginated list of filings filterable by dates, jurisdiction, country and status, and filings can also be retrieved per registration. That covers per-filing status and a date-based view of filings via the API. Missing for 10: an evidenced calendar of upcoming returns, amounts remitted per filing, downloadable filing confirmations, and any UI dashboard or independent corroboration.
